name: e1x_breakeven
description: Break-even ICs with seed intervals: E1x's random-error oracle on a dense IC grid {0.04, ..., 0.10} under five seeds, every construction on the whole cross-section and the deciles, at EFQ 0, 0.7 and 1.0, held for the 15-minute horizon. appendix.py reads it for lookup.csv. 35 tasks of 30 configurations: roughly 25 minutes on 4 cores.
